nodes.label: JWT Auto-Renewal Mechanism in JwtMiddleware
nodes.rationale: Expired JWTs are silently renewed in JwtMiddleware when the session record still exists in customer_sessions, avoiding forced re-login while maintaining revocation capability. Fresh token returned in X-Auth-Token response header.
nodes.norm_label: jwt auto-renewal mechanism in jwtmiddleware

nodes.label: MistServer → Flussonic Media Server Migration (v1.43.0)
nodes.rationale: MistAuthService (MD5 challenge-response) was replaced by FlussonicApiService offering a cleaner Flussonic REST API v3 with TCP pre-check and HTTP→HTTPS auto-detection. The stream_servers table was rebuilt from 60+ MistServer columns to 18 clean Flussonic columns.
nodes.norm_label: mistserver → flussonic media server migration (v1.43.0)

nodes.label: Flutter Player Engine Migration to ExoPlayer (video_player) — final stable choice
nodes.rationale: Player engine oscillated between ExoPlayer (video_player) and MediaKit (MPV). ExoPlayer was chosen as the final engine because it works on all Android TV hardware (including budget Amlogic/Rockchip SoCs) without EGL surface configuration or SoC-specific MPV property tuning.
nodes.norm_label: flutter player engine migration to exoplayer (video_player) — final stable choice
